job-application-autopilot.name: job-application-autopilot
job-application-autopilot.description: End-to-end job application automation: builds a verified master.md from a folder of career material, generates ATS-optimized CVs, finds and applies to jobs, logs everything, drafts recruiter outreach for approval, and triages the inbox into action items.

token-sentinel.name: token-sentinel
token-sentinel.description: A skill for monitoring API token usage and rate limits in a background thread, dynamically adjusting polling frequency, and triggering task resumption upon limit reset.
